parsed.notes: Requirements are those under the 2022 Credit Facility as amended by the Fifth Amendment. The 4.50:1.00 Consolidated Total Leverage Ratio and 1.00:1.00 Senior Secured Leverage Ratio thresholds in the Transaction Letter trigger milestone fees and are not maintenance covenants, so they are excluded. Leverage-based interest margins are also excluded. Subsidiary intercompany credit agreement covenants are excluded as well; Arnold and Velocity were in breach and received waivers, but these loans eliminate in consolidation.
